Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CVX.
We delivered record revenue of $28.8 billion this quarter, representing 4% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 73 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2022.
Our gross margin expanded by 73 basis points to 37.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. We generated $16.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Revenue guidance of $28.8 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
